newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai foreign trade turnover up 10 pct in H1.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai foreign trade turnover up 10 pct in H1.

text.p: Shanghai's foreign trade turnover was up a year-on-year 10 percent to $24.452 billion in the first six months of the year, the Shanghai Securities News said on Monday.
Export volume was up 29 percent to $13.952 billion while import turnover dropped by 8.1 percent to $10.5 billion, the newspaper said.
The increase in export volume was largely due to a rise in exports by foreign-funded companies in Shanghai, which rose by a year-on-year 36.5 percent to $5.243 billion, it said.
Machinery was the biggest single export item, with a value of $4.568 billion, a year-on-year increase of 51.2 percent, the newspaper said.
